_comment: Render inputs for deploy/vps/deploy.sh. The file itself is GENERATED from shared-canonical-services/shared/deployment/deploy_service.py - edit this JSON (or the generator), then re-render: SHARED_CANONICAL_SERVICES=../shared-canonical-services python scripts/check_deploy_generated.py --write. Never hand-edit the .sh: the next render throws your change away. CallAgent joins the shared Traefik edge: docker-compose.satellite.yml attaches the external web network, publishes NO public host ports (a loopback-only 127.0.0.1:8163 mapping serves the deploy health gate - incident 9.2 bans 80/443), and the wildcard *.snapford.com cert is the edge-owned DNS-01 one. SQLite lives in the app-data named volume; PostgreSQL is opt-in via the compose postgres profile.

deploy._comment: Health gate is loopback (fast, no Cloudflare/edge dependency). The surface gate probes the PUBLIC edge after it: robots.txt must contain User-agent, sitemap.xml must contain <urlset - a Traefik label regression or a router 307 rolls the deploy back exactly like a failed health gate. No api_gate_url yet: add one once a light unauthenticated app route exists (pattern: dangwire /api/templates/).
